title_translated: CalibForge：用于扩展可学习终端任务的对抗性求解器校准
summary_translated: 训练终端智能体需要可执行且可验证的任务，这些任务不仅可解，还需对学习过程具有适当挑战性。可执行验证确保可行性，但无法揭示任务相对于特定求解器设置的行为特征。本文提出CalibForge，一个自主的终端任务合成系统，利用经验证的求解器行为，通过对抗性求解器校准来修订候选任务。多求解器校准旨在解决异构求解器池中的分歧，而对比性校准则聚焦于设定的强通过/弱失败关系；两者均以已证明可解性为基础，构建求解器相对的可学习区域。使用CalibForge，我们构建了5,431个校准后的终端任务。消融实验表明，两种策略相比仅靠人工编写和验证，或普通单求解器反馈，能提供更有效的监督信号。在完整数据集上训练的模型在Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别达到32.58%和47.57%的性能。相较于基线模型，最大提升分别达24.71个百分点（Terminal-Bench 2.0）、27.68点（SWE-bench Pro）和30.04点（Doc2Repo）。这些结果支持求解器相对可学习性作为构建高效且可迁移智能体训练数据的实用目标。

summary: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative reward models have not realized their potential in reinforcement learning (RL). Our analysis reveals that this limitation arises from a mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward modeling and the scalar scoring paradigm adopted by existing RL algorithms. To bridge this gap, we propose a Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC) approach, which enables generative reward models to provide more effective RL learning signals by deriving rewards from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking, which exploits comparisons among sampled responses, and anchor-guided ranking, which enables scalable ranking-based reward construction with a small set of reference responses. Experiments across open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RRC substantially improves RL training with generative reward models, achieving consistent gains over existing reward construction approaches. Our code can be found at https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC.
title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
title_translated: RRC：通过基于排序的奖励构造解锁LLM强化学习中的生成式奖励模型
summary_translated: 近期奖励建模的发展标志着从判别式奖励模型向生成式奖励模型的范式转变。然而，尽管生成式奖励模型在响应排序方面表现出强大能力，却尚未在强化学习（RL）中充分发挥潜力。我们的分析表明，这一局限源于生成式奖励建模的比较性质与现有RL算法所采用的标量评分范式的不匹配。为弥合这一差距，我们提出基于排序的奖励构造（RRC）方法，通过从相对偏好排序中推导奖励，使生成式奖励模型能够提供更有效的RL学习信号。RRC引入两种互补策略：自竞争排序，利用采样响应之间的比较；锚点引导排序，通过少量参考响应实现可扩展的基于排序的奖励构造。在开放式对话和推理基准上的实验表明，RRC显著提升了生成式奖励模型的RL训练效果，持续优于现有奖励构造方法。代码详见：https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.
title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
title_translated: 超越Top-K：用可解释的智能体操作替代黑箱检索
summary_translated: 长文档的检索增强生成主要依赖一种设计：将文本分块、嵌入分块、并返回查询的Top-K最近邻。我们认为，对于金融报表、审计报告、监管申报等重要文档类型，这种设计在结构上存在缺陷，并使其可度量化。在一份780页的政府财务报告中，86.8%的内容行是表格行，数千个几乎相同的数值在同一个嵌入空间中竞争，而一个数值的单位通常继承自其上方中位数第13行的表头——因此，分块边界常将数字与其单位（如 lakh 或 crore）分离，造成数量级两阶的错误。虽构建了一个“钢人”式表格感知分块器可修复单位问题，但在所有尝试的分块大小下，仍有27-30%的数值分块缺乏财政年度表头。我们提出READ（可靠无嵌入的智能体文档搜索），其中智能体通过三个确定性操作——标准化词法搜索、结构导航和有界跨度读取——读取原始文档，这些操作通过模型上下文协议暴露，使得整个推理轨迹成为可重放的审计日志，而非不可解释的相似度分数。在51个经验证的问题上，READ准确率达58.8%，远超密集检索的15.7%（p_Holm = 2 × 10^-5）——即使调优后也达35.3%，仍领先23.5个百分点（p_Holm = 0.017）。若给予相同循环但使用Top-K工具的智能体，仅达27.5%，表明性能提升源于接口设计而非迭代本身。我们还指出证据不支持的结论：BM25与READ在统计上无差异，因此本结果区分的是基于嵌入与无嵌入的检索，而非智能体与词法搜索。

summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measuring how well frontier LLMs perform at this task. We introduce HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for end-to-end harness optimization under expensive and stochastic evaluation. An optimizer, an LLM paired with a coding harness, receives a target agent's seed harness, graded evaluation feedback, and a fixed target-evaluation budget. It edits the harness and nominates a final candidate, which is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition that remains inaccessible throughout search. A trusted execution environment enforces the evaluation boundary, meters target-agent resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. We evaluate 5 frontier LLMs as optimizers both under a shared coding harness and under their native harnesses across 4 downstream tasks, over 111 scored runs. Experiment results show that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, native harnesses are not consistently superior, and gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes. These results establish harness optimization as a measurable and discriminative capability with large space for improvement.
title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
title_translated: HarnessOpt-Bench：评估LLMs在Harness优化中的表现
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署于智能体系统中，其能力不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于Harness——即围绕模型的提示、工具、控制流、记忆和编排代码。这使得自动化Harness优化——即AI系统通过迭代和评估引导方式改进Harness——既成为提升AI系统的重要路径，也成为AI系统自身的一项高要求能力。然而，社区尚缺乏衡量前沿LLM在此任务上表现的通用协议。我们引入HarnessOpt-Bench，一个在昂贵且随机评估条件下端到端Harness优化的基准测试。优化器（一个与编码Harness配对的LLM）接收目标智能体的初始Harness、评分评估反馈以及固定的评估预算。它编辑Harness并提名最终候选，该候选在保留的测试集上以归一化增益评分，该测试集在整个搜索过程中不可访问。可信执行环境强制评估边界，计量目标智能体资源使用，并保留候选版本以供审计。我们在4个下游任务上对5个前沿LLM作为优化器进行了评估，共111次评分运行，既在共享编码Harness下，也在其原生Harness下进行。实验结果显示，优化器模型之间的差异大于其所作用的编码Harness，原生Harness并非始终更优，且增益在不同任务和种子设置间变化显著。这些结果确立了Harness优化为一项可测量、具区分性的能力，且仍有巨大提升空间。

summary: We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode.   In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match.   We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.
title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on e-Science (e-Science), Naples, Italy
title_translated: 基于模式的分层信息抽取与生成式AI语义评估
summary_translated: 我们提出了一种基于模式的框架，利用生成式AI从非结构化文本文档中提取复杂且结构化的信息，并对提取结果进行自动化语义评估。该模式作为编码领域知识的信息模型，为分层嵌套信息的提取（包含可变基数属性）提供了一个统一、系统且一致的框架，并支持后续结果评估。信息抽取通过一次模型调用在零样本模式下完成。在评估阶段，我们引入一种基于路径的语义匹配算法，将提取结果中的嵌套可变基数属性与标准答案对齐。我们使用生成式AI对属性的提取值与标准值进行语义比较，并引入评分标准，根据领域特定考量将比较结果分类为精确匹配、语义匹配、有用匹配或不匹配。实验表明，使用生成式AI模型Claude Opus 3，我们从英国卫生技术评估机构NICE发布的文档中成功提取了14个属性中的12个，F1分数超过90%；提取时间比人类领域专家快约30倍。我们还展示了该框架在不同生成式AI模型、不同HTA组织及多语言环境下的泛化能力与可迁移性。

summary: Measuring political bias in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as it can manifest through subtle differences in framing, argumentation, and legal reasoning that are difficult to capture with a single metric. In this work, we introduce Poli-Bias, a counterfactual framework for measuring whether LLMs treat legally equivalent conflict scenarios differently depending on the countries involved. Poli-Bias compares responses to paired prompts in which country identities are systematically swapped across diverse geopolitical relationships, legal violations, and reasoning tasks. Rather than reducing bias to a single judgment, our framework decomposes response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing how and where unequal treatment manifests. Across 13 contemporary LLMs spanning diverse model families and sizes, we find that country identities and user affiliations can systematically affect how equivalent actions are described, evaluated, and defended under international law. Our results thus establish Poli-Bias as a fine-grained framework for auditing political even-handedness and sycophancy in LLMs.
title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
title_translated: Poli-Bias：理解并测量大语言模型在国际政治冲突中的偏见
summary_translated: 衡量大语言模型（LLMs）的政治偏见仍然具有挑战性，因为这种偏见可能以细微的表述差异、论证方式和法律推理差异等形式出现，难以通过单一指标捕捉。本文提出Poli-Bias，一种反事实框架，用于衡量LLMs是否因涉及国家的不同而对法律上等效的冲突情景做出不同处理。Poli-Bias通过系统性地交换多样地缘政治关系、法律违规行为和推理任务中的国家身份，对比成对提示的响应。不同于将偏见简化为单一判断，我们的框架将响应差异分解为五个可解释维度，揭示不平等对待的具体表现方式与位置。在涵盖13种现代LLM（来自不同模型家族和规模）的实验中，我们发现国家身份和用户隶属关系会系统性地影响等效行为在国际法下的描述、评价与辩护方式。因此，Poli-Bias成为审计LLMs政治中立性和谄媚倾向的细粒度工具。

summary: Hospitals are rapidly adopting artificial intelligence for triage, imaging, scheduling etc., yet most deployments remain isolated point solutions locked inside departmental silos, resulting in duplicated effort, hidden risks, and unrealized enterprise value. Despite explosive growth of AI in healthcare market and accelerating investment, an estimated 70-80% of healthcare AI pilots fail to scale, largely due to governance gaps, fragmented data, and missing integration blueprints. This research proposes a hospital-specific, compliance-first, Agentic AI architecture with multiple interoperable layers, extending existing hospital AI platform models with: (i) an Agent Orchestration Layer for multi-agent workflows across clinical, operational, and financial domains, (ii) a Compliance and Policy Layer that centralizes policy-as-code for HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, DISHA Act, India's DPDP Act, and ISO/IEC security and safety standards, and (iii) a Privacy-Preserving Data Fabric that plugs federated learning, differential privacy, and secure enclaves into real-world Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) flows. Using a synthetic but structurally realistic hospital dataset and an open, ready-to-deploy prototype implementation, this study demonstrates the end-to-end orchestration of triage risk prediction, workflow optimization, and compliance logging, achieving substantial simulated reductions in task turnaround times and manual documentation effort while maintaining policy-guarded data access. The resulting architecture offers hospital leaders a pragmatic blueprint to move from ad hoc tools to a governed, globally compliant, ROI-focused AI platform that can be tailored to on-premise, hybrid and cloud-native deployments.
title: From Siloed Algorithms to Compliance-First Agentic Platforms: A Multi-Layered Architecture for Hospital AI Systems
title_translated: 从孤立算法到合规优先的智能体平台：面向医院AI系统的多层架构
summary_translated: 医院正在迅速采用人工智能技术用于分诊、影像分析、排班等场景，但大多数部署仍局限于部门内部的孤立点解决方案，导致重复投入、隐藏风险以及企业价值未被充分释放。尽管医疗AI市场快速增长且投资持续增加，估计仍有70%-80%的医疗AI试点项目无法实现规模化，主要原因在于治理空白、数据碎片化以及缺乏集成蓝图。本研究提出一种面向医院的、以合规为先的智能体AI架构，包含多个可互操作的层级：(i) 智能体编排层，支持临床、运营和财务领域的多智能体工作流；(ii) 合规与策略层，集中管理HIPAA、GDPR、欧盟AI法案、印度DISHA法案、印度DPDP法案以及ISO/IEC安全与标准的策略即代码；(iii) 隐私保护数据底座，将联邦学习、差分隐私和安全飞地集成至真实医院信息系统（HIMS）流程中。通过一个结构合理且合成的医院数据集及一个开源可部署原型实现，本研究展示了从分诊风险预测、工作流优化到合规日志记录的端到端编排，实现了显著的模拟任务周转时间缩短和人工文档工作量减少，同时保障策略约束下的数据访问。该架构为医院管理者提供了一条从零散工具迈向受控、全球合规、注重投资回报的智能体AI平台的务实路线图，适用于本地部署、混合及云原生环境。

summary: This paper presents ECHO (Enhanced Care \& Health Observer), a locally-deployable conversational health assistant for long-term chronic care management. ECHO integrates three complementary software modules developed under shared supervision as a unified system. The core module is an agentic chatbot built on a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph, equipped with 17 clinical tools and a temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory; it achieves a 94.9\% tool-execution pass rate across a 59-scenario benchmark with GPT-5 Mini. A two-stage hybrid safety layer intercepts all incoming queries: a rule-based layer handles explicit crisis signals and jailbreak attempts in under 1ms, while a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8\% accuracy and 90.6\% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B. A multimodal speech assessment module combining Whisper acoustic encoding and BERT text encoding with cross-attention fusion estimates emotion, depression, and pain, reaching a mean macro F1 of 0.652. The full system is implemented as a web application that can run entirely on consumer hardware, with no patient data transmitted to external services, supporting compliance with GDPR and KVKK.
title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
title_translated: ECHO：具备时间记忆、安全防护机制与语音评估功能的本地部署智能体健康助手
summary_translated: 本文介绍ECHO（增强护理与健康观察者），一种用于长期慢性病管理的本地部署对话式健康助手。ECHO整合了三个在共同监督下开发的互补软件模块，形成统一系统。核心模块是一个基于ReAct循环并通过LangGraph编排的智能体聊天机器人，配备17个临床工具和一个时间知识图谱，实现跨会话持久记忆；在GPT-5 Mini上，其在59个场景基准测试中达到94.9%的工具执行成功率。系统采用两级混合安全层拦截所有输入查询：第一层为规则引擎，可在1毫秒内处理明确危机信号和越狱尝试；第二层为经过签名的图神经网络（GNN），采用APPNP风格传播机制，根据临床意图分类边界案例，在2,537条标注的土耳其健康查询数据集上达到88.8%准确率和90.6%不安全召回率，优于包括Llama 3.3 70B在内的零样本LLM基线。一个多模态语音评估模块结合Whisper声学编码与BERT文本编码，并通过交叉注意力融合，用于估计情绪、抑郁和疼痛程度，平均宏F1得分为0.652。整个系统以Web应用形式实现，可在消费级硬件上完全本地运行，患者数据不传输至外部服务，满足GDPR和KVKK合规要求。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit strong Python preferences when generating project-level code, but there is currently no systematic way to measure this behaviour across new models. To bridge this gap, we introduce LangChoiceBench, a project-level code-generation benchmark for measuring Python preference, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity. LangChoiceBench covers 28 projects across seven software areas where Python is often a poor default. We evaluate 25 diverse LLMs and find that Python remains heavily over-selected, recommendation-implementation consistency is low, and smaller open-weight models generally show stronger Python preference and lower language diversity. We further analyse 9,826 reasoning traces and find that most Python choices are automatic or driven primarily by ease, rather than explicit consideration of project requirements. In a smaller but important set of cases, models fabricate contextual support for choosing Python - a failure mode we call phantom evidence - or produce code that contradicts the language selected in their own reasoning.
title: LangChoiceBench: Measuring and Explaining Programming-Language Choice in LLMs
title_translated: LangChoiceBench：测量并解释大语言模型中的编程语言选择行为
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生成项目级代码时表现出强烈的Python偏好，但目前尚无系统方法来衡量这一行为在新模型中的表现。为填补这一空白，我们提出LangChoiceBench，一个用于测量Python偏好、推荐-实现一致性以及语言多样性的项目级代码生成基准。LangChoiceBench覆盖了七个软件领域共28个项目，其中Python常为不合适的默认选择。我们评估了25种不同的LLM，发现Python仍被严重过度选择，推荐与实现的一致性较低，且较小的开源权重模型通常表现出更强的Python偏好和更低的语言多样性。我们进一步分析了9,826条推理轨迹，发现大多数Python选择是自动发生的，或主要由简便性驱动，而非明确考虑项目需求。在少数重要案例中，模型会虚构上下文支持以选择Python——我们称之为“幻觉证据”失败模式——或生成与自身推理中选定语言相矛盾的代码。

summary: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.
title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
title_translated: AppDeltaWorld：面向移动GUI代理的过渡约束型增量代码世界模型
summary_translated: 移动GUI代理可通过像素感知和触控操作来运行应用，使其成为收集和改进长时程移动交互策略的有前景接口。然而，对于敏感应用和隐私关键操作，真实轨迹难以获取。同时，现有的模拟环境在扩展时成本高昂，GUI世界模型仍存在生成不稳定、模态覆盖有限以及动作-过渡逻辑不一致等问题。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了AppDeltaWorld，一种基于过渡约束的增量代码世界模型，该模型将下一界面预测为可到达的代码更新，而非无约束的图像或文本描述。AppDeltaWorld在动作-过渡约束下检索特定应用的Level-1 HTML引用，基于当前屏幕、动作、预测的下一屏文本和检索到的结构生成Level-2可执行HTML，并在浏览器渲染前将生成的视觉资产插入图像槽中。作为世界模型，AppDeltaWorld在Code2World评估下的CMGUIBench-500上实现了最高保真度，在结构布局和UI元素重建方面显著优于仅图像或仅代码的基线方法。作为训练环境，AppDeltaWorld支持过滤后的闭环SFT数据构建，结合公开监督，使AppDeltaAgent在AndroidLens上达到最先进性能，并在MobileGym和MobileWorld上实现持续提升。此外，基于世界模型的测试时强化学习可实现策略自适应，并在无需与真实应用进一步交互的情况下带来进一步改进。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) can leave small stylistic traces in text written with their help. The most discussed is the em-dash (U+2014), especially the unspaced form word---word, which is normal in typeset English prose but unusual in U.S. press writing, where AP style calls for spaced dashes. This study asks whether that trace is measurable in congressional press releases. In a preregistered design (OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY), 146,239 scraper-sourced releases from 480 House and Senate offices (2021-2025, the open congress-press dataset) were analyzed: density of unspaced prose-form em-dashes per 1,000 characters of cleaned text, Poisson/negative-binomial models with a length offset, clustering by office. Density stayed within 0.10-0.12 per 1,000 characters through 2021-2024, then rose to 0.217 in 2025, more than twice the four-year baseline; the share of releases with such an em-dash rose from ~13% to 24.8%. The primary frequency ratio (2023-2025 vs 2021-2022) was 1.55 (95% CI 1.28-1.93; exact registered cut-off: 1.528), just above the prespecified 1.5x threshold. The rise was net-new (hyphen density stable), held within authors (75.6% of 262 continuous offices increased; p ~ 1e-16) and in a closed panel of 224 offices, and survived falsification tests: three placebo cut-offs were null, the pipeline showed no step at the 2024/2025 boundary, and continuing offices carried the rise. A segmented regression finds no step at the ChatGPT cut-off but a clear post-period acceleration; the 2025 rise is symmetric across parties and chambers. Because the registered validation gate was formally breached, the full preregistered decision rule was not met; the interpretation (broad diffusion of LLM-assisted writing as the models matured) is offered as exploratory. The em-dash remains a population-level marker, not a per-release authorship detector, and the design supports no causal claim.
title: The em-dash em-beds in Congress: A population-level rise in em-dash frequency in U.S. congressional press releases at the dawn of the large-language-model era, 2021-2025
comment: Preregistered study (OSF: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY%29%3B deviations from the registered plan, including a formal validation-gate breach, are disclosed in Section 4.6. Companion study: arXiv:2606.29540 . 3 figures, 4 tables
title_translated: 连字符在国会中的嵌入：大语言模型时代初期（2021–2025）美国国会新闻稿中连字符频率的群体水平上升
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在使用其辅助撰写的文本中可能留下细微的风格痕迹。其中最受关注的是连字符（U+2014），尤其是无空格形式的词---词，这种形式在排版英语散文中常见，但在美国新闻写作中不常见，因为美联社（AP）风格要求使用带空格的破折号。本研究探讨这一痕迹是否可在国会新闻稿中被测量。在一项预注册设计中（OSF: 10.17605/OSF.IO/U5NEY），分析了来自480个众议院和参议院办公室的146,239份爬取自2021–2025年的新闻稿（开放国会新闻数据集）：每1000个字符清洁文本中无空格散文式连字符的密度，采用泊松/负二项分布模型并包含长度偏移量，按办公室聚类分析。2021–2024年期间，密度保持在每1000字符0.10–0.12之间，2025年上升至0.217，超过此前四年基线的两倍；含有此类连字符的新闻稿比例从约13%上升至24.8%。主要频率比（2023–2025 vs 2021–2022）为1.55（95%置信区间1.28–1.93；注册截止值1.528），略高于预先设定的1.5倍阈值。该上升是净新增（连字符密度稳定），在作者层面（262个连续办公室中有75.6%增加；p ~ 1e-16）和224个封闭小组内均成立，并通过了虚假检验：三个安慰剂截断点均为零，流程在2024/2025边界无突变，持续办公单位也延续了上升趋势。分段回归显示在ChatGPT发布节点处无突变，但后期存在明显加速；2025年的上升在两党及两院间对称分布。由于注册验证门限被正式突破，完整预注册决策规则未满足；解释（随着模型成熟，LLM辅助写作广泛扩散）作为探索性观点提出。连字符仍是群体水平的标记，而非单篇稿件的作者识别工具，且该设计不支持因果推断。

summary: Existing guidance identifies excessive agency, excessive permission, weak task-bound authorization, and inadequate agent controls as important risks. Control frameworks also describe capabilities for constraining, authorizing, observing, validating, and responding to agent activity. Yet security programs still need a way to manage persistent deployed instances that span components and outlive any one event.   We propose the agentic posture vulnerability (APV) as a task-conditioned vulnerability-management abstraction: a durable record for a composed agent-control exposure. One posture may produce different runtime manifestations across tasks; APV links those manifestations to the invariant posture and remains open until authority is narrowed, a missing control is added, risk is accepted, or closure is verified. APV is not proposed as a new root-cause class of risk; it operationalizes existing excessive-agency, authorization, and control-composition weaknesses.   We distinguish APVs from CVE-addressable product defects, OWASP Excessive Agency, Agent Baseline control outcomes, and the runtime authorization-execution gap. We then provide a field vignette, a thresholded definition, six recurring APV patterns, a vulnerability lifecycle, a minimum record, a control-and-closure matrix, tooling implications, and a testable research agenda.
title: The Vulnerability With No CVE: Managing Persistent Gaps Between Mandate and Authority in AI Coding Agents
authors: Shayell Aharon Salomon Amir Shaked Matan Noga
title_translated: 无CVE的漏洞：管理AI编码代理中使命与权限之间的持久差距
summary_translated: 现有指导指出过度自主、过度权限、任务绑定授权薄弱以及代理控制不足是重要风险。控制框架也描述了限制、授权、监控、验证和响应代理活动的能力。然而，安全项目仍需一种方法来管理跨越组件、超出单一事件生命周期的持续部署实例。我们提出代理姿态漏洞（APV）作为一种任务条件化的漏洞管理抽象：用于记录复合代理控制暴露的持久化记录。一个姿态可能在不同任务中产生不同的运行时表现；APV将这些表现与不变的姿态关联起来，并在权限缩小、缺失控制被补充、风险被接受或关闭被验证之前保持开放状态。APV并非作为新的根本原因风险类别提出；而是对现有过度自主、授权和控制组合弱点的操作化体现。我们区分APV与可由CVE处理的产品缺陷、OWASP过度自主、代理基线控制结果以及运行时授权-执行差距。随后，我们提供了一个实地案例、阈值定义、六种常见的APV模式、漏洞生命周期、最小记录、控制与关闭矩阵、工具影响以及可测试的研究议程。

summary: User requests serve as research specifications for deep research agents, shaping what evidence to seek and how to synthesize it. In personalized deep research, these specifications must additionally reflect user goals, constraints, preferences, and evaluation criteria. User context can be incorporated either within the deep research pipeline or into the research specification provided as its input. We focus on the latter, refining the user request into a personalized research specification before passing it to an unchanged deep research agent. This requires resolving three coupled decisions: which framing factors are relevant, whether the available user context sufficiently supports them, and whether to retrieve user memory, ask the user, or stop and refine the query. For training, G-STEER organizes framing factors as elicitation targets in an Intent Elicitation Graph that captures their dependencies. It learns a clarification policy from graph-scaffolded trajectories spanning diverse factor dependencies and evidence conditions. The policy produces a refined query while balancing target coverage against the costs of evidence acquisition. Experiments show that G-STEER achieves the strongest overall weighted target coverage and the highest downstream report personalization across both evaluated DRAs, while asking roughly one third as many user questions as a strong clarification baseline.
title: Personalized Deep Research Query Refinement with Graph-Scaffolded Evidence Grounding
title_translated: 基于图结构引导证据定位的个性化深度研究查询优化
summary_translated: 用户请求作为深度研究代理的研究规范，决定了应寻找哪些证据以及如何综合它们。在个性化深度研究中，这些规范还需反映用户目标、约束、偏好和评估标准。用户上下文可被整合进深度研究流程中，或作为输入提供给研究规范。我们聚焦后者，在将请求传递给不变的深度研究代理之前，将其优化为个性化研究规范。这需要解决三个耦合决策：哪些框架因素相关，可用的用户上下文是否足以支持这些因素，以及是否应检索用户记忆、询问用户还是停止并优化查询。在训练中，G-STEER将框架因素组织为意图获取图中的获取目标，以捕捉其依赖关系。它从涵盖多样化因素依赖和证据条件的图结构轨迹中学习澄清策略。该策略在目标覆盖率与证据获取成本之间取得平衡。实验表明，G-STEER在两个评估的DRAs中均实现了最强的整体加权目标覆盖率和最高的下游报告个性化，同时提出的问题数量仅为强基线澄清策略的约三分之一。

summary: Self-evolving agents accumulate capability by distilling reusable skills from their execution trajectories, but we find this process is not monotonic: past a critical pool size, newly added skills degrade performance instead of improving it. We formalize this capability-contamination phase transition and trace it to a structural cause: once a defective skill enters the decision context, it becomes reference material for distilling later skills, forming cross-round contamination chains. We further show the contamination is structurally irreversible: removing a source skill after the fact cannot erase the flawed reasoning its descendants have already inherited, so post-hoc rollback recovers only a small fraction of the lost performance. This makes skill admission a pre-commit necessity rather than a post-hoc fix, and motivates Verifier-as-Gatekeeper (VaG): a progressive trust hierarchy whose three heterogeneous critics - structural validity, behavioral harmlessness, and semantic consistency - filter each skill individually, coupled with a marginal-gain subset selection that removes combinatorial contamination at the top tier before skills reach the runtime context. On Terminal-Bench 2, unconditional accumulation rises to a peak and then degrades, giving back most of its gains as the pool keeps growing, and post-hoc removal of the culprit skills recovers only a small part of the drop - the empirical signature of irreversibility. In contrast, VaG improves every round, reaching 72% pass@1 with a pool roughly 5x smaller, and its frozen skill pool transfers positively to four other backbones and a second benchmark without re-evolution. Ablations confirm the three critics are complementary and mutually non-substitutable, each intercepting a largely disjoint class of harmful skills.
title: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
title_translated: 自我进化反噬之时：预提交门控机制防止LLM代理中的技能污染
summary_translated: 自我演化的代理通过从执行轨迹中提炼可重用技能来积累能力，但我们发现这一过程并非单调：一旦达到临界池大小，新加入的技能反而会降低性能而非提升。我们形式化了这一能力污染相变现象，并追溯其结构性根源：一旦缺陷技能进入决策上下文，它便成为后续技能提炼的参考材料，形成跨轮次的污染链。我们进一步证明污染具有结构性不可逆性：事后移除源技能无法消除其后代已继承的错误推理，因此事后回滚只能恢复少量性能损失。这使得技能准入成为预提交的必要措施，而非事后修复。为此我们提出验证器即守门人（VaG）：一种渐进信任层级，包含三种异构批评者——结构有效性、行为无害性和语义一致性——分别独立筛选每个技能，并结合边际增益子集选择，在技能进入运行时上下文前去除组合污染。在Terminal-Bench 2上，无条件累积先上升后下降，随着池持续增长，大部分收益被回吐；事后移除问题技能仅能部分恢复下降——这是不可逆性的实证特征。相比之下，VaG每轮均提升，以约五分之一的池规模达到72% pass@1，其冻结的技能池在四个其他骨干网络和第二个基准测试中均表现出正迁移，无需重新演化。消融实验确认三类批评者互补且互不可替代，各自拦截了大量不重叠的有害技能类型。

summary: Task difficulty dictates an agent's likelihood of success, and estimating it without rollouts means forecasting this directly from a task description before executing costly simulations in stateful environments. Reliable estimates would therefore allow environment designers to calibrate evaluation benchmarks and construct progressive training curricula. This becomes increasingly important as agents move into long-horizon domains, where empirical trial-and-error is a severe computational bottleneck. Prior work on early prediction is limited to static tasks or isolated coding environments, often relying on narrow features and inaccurate evaluation metrics. We study \textit{ex ante} difficulty prediction across 17 agentic benchmarks spanning coding, mathematics, machine learning, web navigation, function calling, and other domains. We show that AUC can mask poor difficulty estimates, identify token-level entropy as a useful predictive signal, and show how residuals between expected and observed difficulty can expose hidden environment flaws such as contamination and infeasibility.
title: Predicting Task Difficulty Without Rollouts
title_translated: 无需模拟即可预测任务难度
summary_translated: 任务难度决定了智能体成功可能性，而无需模拟的难度估计意味着在执行状态环境中的昂贵模拟之前，仅从任务描述直接预测该难度。可靠的估计将使环境设计者能够校准评估基准并构建渐进式训练课程。随着智能体进入长时域领域，这种能力变得愈发重要，因为经验性的试错会成为严重的计算瓶颈。以往关于早期预测的研究局限于静态任务或孤立的编码环境，通常依赖于狭窄特征和不准确的评估指标。我们研究了跨越17个智能体基准（包括编程、数学、机器学习、网页导航、函数调用等）的先验难度预测。我们发现AUC可能掩盖较差的难度估计，识别出词级熵是一个有用的预测信号，并展示了期望与实际难度之间的残差如何暴露隐藏的环境缺陷，如污染和不可行性。

summary: Machine unlearning has become a critical capability for safely removing specific, sensitive knowledge from large language models (LLMs). Current state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on iterative, training-time unlearning via fine-tuning. However, even when utilizing parameter-efficient dimensionality reduction techniques like LoRA, gradient-based optimization remains computationally expensive and lacks explicit analytical formulations. It can also leave the targeted knowledge merely hidden rather than removed, to the point that simply quantizing the unlearned model restores much of what it was supposed to have erased. To resolve this, we propose a novel one-shot unlearning approach, abandoning iterative optimization in favor of a direct, exact analytical solution. We frame the unlearning process as a ridge-regularized least-squares optimization problem, deriving a closed-form additive update for targeted weight matrices. This update forces the selected layer to suppress unwanted content while strictly preserving its behavior on retained data. Computed from gradient-free forward passes alone, with no backpropagation and no iteration to convergence, GROM applies the weight edit in mere seconds, which makes it orders of magnitude faster than traditional fine-tuning. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that GROM achieves state-of-the-art forgetting-utility trade-offs on TOFU-5%, TOFU-10%, MUSE-Books, MUSE-News and WMDP, significantly reducing computational overhead without sacrificing overall model performance. Because the update removes the targeted content from the weights instead of masking it, GROM also withstands the low-bit quantization attack that recovers much of the content a gradient-based baseline had appeared to forget. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/GROM.
title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
title_translated: GROM：无梯度快速一次性机器遗忘
summary_translated: 机器遗忘已成为安全移除大型语言模型（LLM）中特定敏感知识的关键能力。当前最先进的方法主要依赖于通过微调实现的迭代式训练期遗忘。然而，即使使用LoRA等参数高效的降维技术，基于梯度的优化仍然计算成本高昂且缺乏明确的解析公式。此外，它可能只是将目标知识隐藏而非真正删除，以至于简单地对遗忘后的模型进行低比特量化就能恢复大部分本应被清除的内容。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的一次性遗忘方法，摒弃迭代优化，转而采用直接的精确解析解。我们将遗忘过程建模为带有岭正则化的最小二乘优化问题，推导出针对目标权重矩阵的闭式加法更新。该更新强制选定层抑制不需要的内容，同时严格保持其在保留数据上的行为。仅通过无梯度的前向传播计算，无需反向传播和收敛迭代，GROM可在数秒内完成权重修改，速度比传统微调快几个数量级。大量实验表明，GROM在TOFU-5%、TOFU-10%、MUSE-Books、MUSE-News和WMDP上实现了最先进的遗忘-效用权衡，显著降低了计算开销而不牺牲整体模型性能。由于更新是从权重中真正移除目标内容而非掩蔽，GROM还能抵御低比特量化攻击——这种攻击能恢复基于梯度的基线看似已遗忘的内容。代码已公开于https://github.com/Batorskq/GROM。

summary: As capabilities rapidly increase, AI agents can move from running inside one app to acting across a user's devices over time. Yet existing agent systems still fall short in this scenario. This is because observations are scattered across devices and moments, but mainstream systems are not designed around this fact: a single agent that treats devices as tools lacks effective state management for all devices across time, and multi-agent systems coordinate across agents but do not maintain the compact carried state a cross-device, cross-time request needs. We argue that the agent should maintain an effectively designed state that organizes engagement evidence, stated facts, and the standing request in a compact, action-ready form for deciding its action given the current observation. To compare state designs, we construct a benchmark of user-agent interaction across devices and time. We instantiate this principle in Unified Agent, a stateful agent that carries interaction evidence across devices and moments and uses it with the current observation to act. In the default setting, it significantly outperforms our adaptations of four published designs. Across changes in multimodal large language model (MLLM) family, capability, and reasoning effort, it remains ahead of all compared systems, demonstrating that the state-design advantage is robust across MLLM settings. Our code and data will be publicly available on GitHub.
title: Unified Agent: Managing Interactions across Devices
title_translated: 统一智能体：跨设备交互管理
summary_translated: 随着能力迅速提升，AI智能体可从单一应用内运行演变为随时间在用户多个设备间协同行动。然而，现有智能体系统在此场景下仍显不足。这是因为观察信息分散在不同设备和时间点，而主流系统并未围绕这一事实设计：单智能体系统虽将设备视为工具，但缺乏对所有设备跨时间的有效状态管理；多智能体系统虽能协调多个智能体，却无法维持跨设备、跨时间请求所需的紧凑携带状态。我们认为，智能体应维护一个经过有效设计的状态，以紧凑、可操作的形式组织交互证据、陈述事实和待处理请求，从而根据当前观察做出决策。为比较状态设计，我们构建了一个跨设备和时间的用户-智能体交互基准。我们在此原则基础上实现了统一智能体（Unified Agent），这是一个有状态的智能体，能够跨设备和时间携带交互证据，并结合当前观察采取行动。在默认设置下，其显著优于四种已发表设计的变体。在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）家族、能力水平和推理努力程度变化的情况下，它始终优于所有对比系统，表明该状态设计优势在不同MLLM设置下具有鲁棒性。代码和数据将公开于GitHub。

summary: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly invoke external tools and interact with real-world systems, unsafe actions may cause irreversible consequences on external states, user data, and downstream services. Recent runtime guardrails mitigate such risks by checking proposed actions before execution, but many remain reactive: they primarily assess the apparent safety of the current action, lacking an explicit model of how risk evolves across the trajectory. This limitation creates a critical blind spot for long-horizon risks, where individually benign-looking actions can gradually drift the agent toward hazardous states. In response, we propose DreamGuard, a proactive guardrail for LLM agents built around a risk-aware world model. The world model maintains a compact recurrent latent state over the trajectory and predicts future latent states from which DreamGuard derives immediate-hazard and prefix-risk evidence. It then fuses these multi-horizon signals into intervention decisions before execution. Experiments across four benchmarks and an online guardrail evaluation show that DreamGuard outperforms generic, reactive, and proactive guardrail baselines, achieves the best safety-utility trade-off among evaluated guardrails, and maintains an average end-to-end latency of 25 ms per call.
title: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
title_translated: DreamGuard：基于风险感知世界模型的高效运行时防护机制
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地调用外部工具并与真实系统交互，不安全行为可能对外部状态、用户数据和下游服务造成不可逆后果。近期的运行时防护机制通过在执行前检查提议动作来缓解此类风险，但许多方法仍属被动：它们主要评估当前动作的表面安全性，缺乏对风险在整个轨迹中演变的显式建模。这一局限性在长时域风险中形成关键盲区，因为单独看似无害的动作可能逐渐引导智能体走向危险状态。为此，我们提出DreamGuard，一种基于风险感知世界模型的主动防护机制。该世界模型在轨迹上维护一个紧凑的递归隐状态，并从未来隐状态中预测风险，从而生成即时危害和前缀风险证据。随后，它将这些多时域信号融合为执行前的干预决策。在四个基准测试及在线防护评估中，DreamGuard优于通用、被动和主动防护基线，实现了所评估防护机制中的最佳安全-效用权衡，并保持每调用平均25毫秒的端到端延迟。

summary: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintroducing shortcut-prone information. We identify this trade-off and propose a three-stream detector that combines motion with two restricted views of location. A coarse region reader based on vector quantization and a fine direction reader over normalized multi-layer states. This design restores enough state context to interpret the motion without returning to full-state probing. On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, our method improves selection accuracy by up to 12% over the displacement-only state of the art and 21% over single-layer probing baselines. Although trained only on reasoning benchmarks, it also reads factual completion and fact verification, ahead of every detector we compare against, which places the signal on correctness rather than on a kind of reasoning. Ablations further show that motion, region, and direction provide complementary signals. These results suggest that reasoning validity is better read from state-conditioned motion than from either static states or decontextualized trajectories alone.
title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
title_translated: 推理错误在LLM残差流轨迹中具有区域与方向
summary_translated: 随着语言模型越来越多地用于需要可验证推理的任务，可靠区分正确推理与错误推理已成为一个重要实践问题。近期基于轨迹的方法试图在逐层残差流位移中寻找该信号，这些位移捕捉表示的变化，同时削弱部分稳定的、与词相关的冗余信息。然而，位移忽略了更新的起始状态，而恢复完整状态又可能重新引入易产生捷径的冗余信息。我们识别出这一权衡，并提出一种三流检测器，将运动信息与两个受限的位置视图相结合：基于向量量化的粗粒度区域读取器，以及基于归一化多层状态的精细方向读取器。该设计恢复了足够的状态上下文以解释运动，同时避免返回全状态探测。在训练期间未见过的推理基准上，我们的方法相比仅使用位移的最先进方法提升了最高12%的选择准确率，相比单层探测基线提升了21%。尽管仅在推理基准上训练，它在事实补全和事实验证任务上也优于所有对比检测器，将信号定位在正确性本身而非某种推理类型上。消融实验进一步表明，运动、区域和方向提供了互补信号。这些结果表明，推理有效性更应从状态条件下的运动中读取，而非仅从静态状态或去上下文的轨迹中获取。

summary: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solutions. The method samples multiple independent reasoning rollouts, refines each rollout through iterative self-critique and self-correction, and aggregates the refined answers by majority voting. Breadth preserves diverse initial attempts, while depth repairs local reasoning errors before aggregation. Across AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, our method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-$N$, beam search, and lookahead decoding across multiple open-weight models. For instance, with Qwen2.5-1.5B, accuracy increases from the strongest verifier-based baseline to $58.0\%$ on MATH500, and from $25.0\%$ to $32.5\%$ on AMC. These results show that test-time compute can be more effective when used to refine sampled trajectories rather than only to sample more candidates or rely on verifier-guided selection.
title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
title_translated: 通过重采样优化：大语言模型推理的测试时自我修正
summary_translated: 测试时扩展通过使用额外的推理计算提升大语言模型的推理能力，但仅扩大采样范围往往面临收益递减：新的推理轨迹通常重复已有答案模式，而非引入有用的推理多样性。基于验证器的选择提供了一种替代方案，但其性能依赖于外部奖励模型的校准。我们提出一种无需验证器的广度-深度精炼框架，利用测试时计算来探索并改进候选解决方案。该方法生成多个独立的推理轨迹，通过迭代的自我批判与自我修正对每条轨迹进行精炼，并通过多数投票聚合精炼后的答案。广度保留了多样化的初始尝试，而深度则在聚合前修复局部推理错误。在AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench和MATH500等多个基准上，我们的方法持续优于贪婪解码、多数投票、基于验证器的最佳N选一、束搜索和前瞻解码，适用于多种开源模型。例如，在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上，MATH500的准确率从最强的基于验证器基线提升至58.0%，AMC的准确率从25.0%提升至32.5%。结果表明，当测试时计算用于精炼采样轨迹而非仅增加候选数量或依赖验证器引导选择时，其效果更为显著。

summary: Sycophantic responses are becoming pervasive in large language models (LLMs), and prior work has pointed out that some of them could be harmful. This paper focuses on one harmful sycophancy: preference-induced stance reversal sycophancy (PSRS), where a model reverses an initial stance merely to align with a user's stated preference. While existing research mainly measures how sycophantic a model is, we go further and ask whether PSRS can also be detected automatically from a single response. To investigate this at scale, we introduce CAP (Contrastive Anchor Probing), a framework for collecting labeled PSRS data. Applying CAP to 17 open- and closed-source LLMs, we collect 290,460 labeled responses across 12 everyday-advice domains. We organize our study around three research questions. (1) How often does PSRS occur? (2) How well can it be detected? (3) How does detection generalize to unseen models? We first reveal that PSRS rates range from 5% to 56% across LLMs, with more capable models being less sycophantic. Next, we show that detecting PSRS is feasible from the response text alone, and detectors need to learn subtle PSRS patterns from the training data. Because new LLMs appear rapidly, detectors inevitably encounter unseen models, making cross-model generalization an important framework goal. We demonstrate that detection performance drops on unseen models and propose an initial approach to address this challenge. We will release our dataset and code to support future research.
title: Measuring and Detecting Harmful AI Sycophancy
title_translated: 衡量与检测有害的AI奉承行为
summary_translated: 奉承式回应在大型语言模型中日益普遍，先前研究指出其中部分可能具有危害性。本文聚焦于一种有害的奉承形式：由用户偏好引发的姿态反转奉承（PSRS），即模型仅因迎合用户声明的偏好而改变其初始立场。尽管现有研究主要衡量模型的奉承程度，我们进一步探讨是否可从单个响应中自动检测PSRS。为大规模研究此问题，我们提出了CAP（对比锚点探测）框架，用于收集带标签的PSRS数据。将CAP应用于17个开源与闭源大语言模型，我们在12个日常建议领域收集了290,460条带标签的响应。研究围绕三个核心问题展开：(1) PSRS发生的频率如何？(2) 能否有效检测？(3) 检测性能在未见模型上的泛化能力如何？我们首先发现，不同模型的PSRS率介于5%至56%之间，能力越强的模型奉承倾向越低。接着，我们证明仅从响应文本即可实现PSRS检测，且检测器需从训练数据中学习细微的PSRS模式。由于新模型快速涌现，检测器不可避免会遇到未见过的模型，因此跨模型泛化成为关键目标。我们展示了检测性能在未见模型上下降，并提出初步应对策略。我们将公开数据集与代码以支持后续研究。

summary: Timely anticipation of physical hazards is essential for real-world safety, yet existing MLLM evaluations focus on harmful content or general risks, leaving proactive physical hazard prediction underexplored. Sports provide a well-suited testbed: accident causes span diverse injury dimensions and pre-accident spatiotemporal cues draw on reasoning capabilities shared with broader safety domains such as autonomous driving and fall detection. We introduce SPRINT (Sports Proactive Risk INference Testbed), a benchmark of 2,888 real-world sports videos (2,440 accident, 448 safe controls) spanning 14 sports and 3 environmental settings. Accident videos feature fine-grained annotations of early hazard cues, accident timing, and hierarchical causes; safe videos are manually verified as accident-free and serve to diagnose prompt-induced false alarms. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs under diverse prompts and temporal windows reveals a sharp gap between hazard sensitivity and understanding: the best model exceeds 95% in signaling hazards yet falls below 50% in identifying their causes. Diagnostic experiments further show that explicit danger queries trigger severe false alarms even on hazard-free videos. These findings indicate that current MLLMs exhibit only superficial proactive safety, lacking stable, cause-grounded early warning, and underscore the need for reliable proactive safety in dynamic physical environments. Data and code will be open-sourced upon acceptance.
title: From Sports to Safety: Benchmarking Proactive Risk Inference in MLLMs
title_translated: 从体育到安全：多模态大语言模型主动风险推理的基准测试
summary_translated: 及时预判物理危险对现实世界安全至关重要，但现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估主要关注有害内容或一般风险，对主动物理危险预测的研究仍显不足。体育场景提供了理想的测试环境：事故原因涵盖多样化的伤害维度，且事故前的时空线索依赖于与自动驾驶、跌倒检测等更广泛安全领域共享的推理能力。我们提出SPRINT（体育主动风险推理测试平台），一个包含2,888段真实体育视频的基准数据集（2,440段事故视频，448段安全对照视频），覆盖14项运动和3种环境设置。事故视频包含早期危险线索、事故发生时间及层级化原因的细粒度标注；安全视频经人工验证无事故，用于诊断提示引发的误报。在多种提示和时间窗口下评估最先进MLLM的表现，揭示出危险敏感性与理解能力之间的巨大差距：最佳模型在警示危险方面超过95%准确率，但在识别原因方面低于50%。诊断实验进一步显示，明确询问危险的提示即使在无危险视频上也会引发严重误报。这些发现表明，当前MLLM的主动安全能力仅为表面层次，缺乏稳定、基于因果的早期预警机制，凸显了在动态物理环境中实现可靠主动安全的迫切需求。数据与代码将在论文接受后开源。

summary: Agent benchmarks usually measure task completion and treat resource use as an auxiliary statistic. In deployment, however, the choice among a local lookup, broad search, composite research tool, stronger model, or human escalation is part of the task itself. We introduce EcoAgent-Bench, in which every task specifies priced actions and an explicit budget. Its 304 real-derived tasks span five families adapted from GAIA, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue, and test four decisions: avoiding unnecessary escalation, escalating when local evidence is insufficient, selecting a model tier, and stopping on unsupported premises. We evaluate seven LLM agents in tool-API and workspace-CLI settings, together with four oracle scripted controls. Micro-averaged accuracy rewards one-sided policies: always-escalate controls achieve high micro success while failing save-oriented tasks. We therefore also report an economic-consistency score (the worse of accuracy on upgrade-oriented and save-oriented family groups) which exposes this failure. Tool-API agents attain only 3.9-24.0% micro strict success (at most 7.3% economic consistency), often either stopping before warranted escalation or overspending on cheap tasks. A threshold-crossing budget sweep changes GPT-5.4's escalation rate from 0% to only 3%. These results show that completion under a budget and economical action selection are distinct properties. We release the task bundle, transformation pipeline, frozen evaluation environments, and integrity-bound result artifacts needed to study both.
title: EcoAgent-Bench: Evaluating Economic Decision-Making in Budget-Constrained LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Benchmark, dataset (304 budget-conditioned agent tasks), and evaluation harness; artifacts to be released
title_translated: EcoAgent-Bench：预算约束下大语言模型智能体经济决策能力的评估
summary_translated: 传统智能体基准通常衡量任务完成情况，将资源使用视为辅助统计量。然而在实际部署中，选择本地查询、广泛搜索、复合研究工具、更强模型或人工升级本身即是任务的一部分。我们提出EcoAgent-Bench，其中每个任务均指定动作价格和明确预算。该基准包含304个源自真实场景的任务，涵盖五个家族，改编自GAIA、HotpotQA和MuSiQue，用于测试四项关键决策：避免不必要的升级、在本地证据不足时升级、选择模型层级，以及在前提不支持时停止。我们在工具-API和工作区-CLI两种设置下评估七种LLM智能体，同时包含四种基于脚本的基准控制。微平均准确率奖励单一方向策略：始终升级的控制组在微平均成功上表现优异，但在节约导向任务中失败。因此我们还报告了经济一致性得分（升级导向与节约导向任务组准确率中的较差值），以暴露这一缺陷。工具-API智能体的微严格成功率仅为3.9%-24.0%（最高经济一致性仅7.3%），常在应升级前停止或在廉价任务上过度支出。阈值跨越的预算扫描使GPT-5.4的升级率从0%提升至仅3%。这些结果表明，在预算下完成任务与经济性行动选择是两个独立属性。我们发布任务包、转换管道、冻结的评估环境及完整性绑定的结果制品，以支持相关研究。

summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used to interact with external services via programs written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Unfortunately, since DSLs are often low-resource and esoteric, LMs frequently produce syntactically invalid programs in these languages. Grammar-constrained decoding can eliminate such failures, but requires syntactic constraints. These are usually in the form of a context-free grammar for the target language, an artifact that is hard to come by for third-party DSLs. In this work, we define an agent, called Autogrammar, that automatically learns context-free grammars from documentation and execution data. Autogrammar is formalized as a Kripke structure whose nondeterministic choices are resolved by a language model, enabling declarative control of agent behavior via linear temporal logic constraints. We evaluate four versions of Autogrammar on three DSLs (i.e., Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights, Dynatrace Query Language, and Datadog Search Syntax) and find that it generates grammars that achieve near perfect precision on unseen data; that temporal restrictions reduce execution time by 3.8x without incurring statistically-significant loss in precision; that execution data is crucial while documentation is dispensable; and that grammar-constrained decoding using Autogrammar-generated grammars significantly improves end-to-end LM performance on eight out of ten real tasks, matching or exceeding the performance of a professionally-maintained grammar. In comparison, the context-free grammars generated by existing LM baselines and a state-of-the-art formal technique perform significantly worse over the same evaluation.
title: Learning Context-Free Grammars for Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Declarative Agentic Programming with Guarantees
title_translated: 通过带保证的声明式代理编程学习上下文无关文法以实现语法约束解码
summary_translated: 语言模型（LMs）越来越多地通过特定领域语言（DSL）编写的程序与外部服务交互。然而，由于DSL通常资源匮乏且晦涩难懂，语言模型在这些语言中经常生成语法无效的程序。语法约束解码可消除此类错误，但需要语法约束。这些约束通常以目标语言的上下文无关文法形式存在，而第三方DSL往往难以获取此类文法。在此工作中，我们定义了一个名为Autogrammar的智能体，能够从文档和执行数据中自动学习上下文无关文法。Autogrammar被形式化为一个Kripke结构，其非确定性选择由语言模型决定，从而可通过线性时序逻辑约束实现对代理行为的声明式控制。我们在三个DSL（Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights、Dynatrace Query Language和Datadog Search Syntax）上评估了Autogrammar的四个版本，发现其生成的文法在未见数据上实现了近乎完美的精确率；时间限制能将执行时间减少3.8倍，且未造成统计上显著的精度损失；执行数据至关重要，而文档则可忽略；使用Autogrammar生成的文法进行语法约束解码，在十个真实任务中有八个显著提升了端到端语言模型性能，达到甚至超过专业维护文法的水平。相比之下，现有语言模型基线和最先进的形式化技术生成的上下文无关文法在相同评估中表现显著更差。

summary: Graphical Abstracts (GAs) visually summarize the key findings of academic papers, playing a crucial role in facilitating the understanding of research content. Recently, advancements in vision-language models and image generation models have enabled the automatic generation of scientific figures based on paper content. However, most conventional methods output the generated results as raster graphics, making post-editing (e.g., text modification and layout changes) highly difficult. This poses a significant challenge, as they are unsuitable for the iterative figure revision process inherent in paper writing and peer review. To tackle these challenges, we define the novel task of generating editable GAs from paper content and propose GenGA, a new GA generation framework that directly produces figures in vector format. By generating figures as a collection of vector elements with a hierarchical structure, GenGA produces outputs that can be seamlessly imported into existing drawing tools for intuitive, element-level editing. Furthermore, we introduce the Structural Independence Coefficient (SIC), a metric that quantifies the editing simplicity of a figure based on the degree to which local modifications propagate to other elements. Experimental results show that GenGA achieves superior editing simplicity compared to conventional methods, and even surpasses human-authored GAs in conciseness and semantic alignment. We also validate SIC as an effective metric correlated with manual editing costs. This study fundamentally redefines GA generation as an editable vector graphic generation problem grounded in the practical workflows of researchers, significantly promoting effective scientific communication.
title: GenGA: Editable and Data-Grounded Graphical Abstract Generation for Academic Papers
title_translated: GenGA：可编辑且数据驱动的学术论文图形摘要生成
summary_translated: 图形摘要（GAs）通过视觉方式总结学术论文的核心发现，在促进研究内容理解方面起着关键作用。近年来，视觉-语言模型和图像生成模型的进步使得可以根据论文内容自动生成科学图表。然而，大多数传统方法输出的结果为位图格式，导致后期编辑（如文本修改和版式调整）极为困难。这带来了显著挑战，因为它们不适用于论文撰写和同行评审中固有的迭代图表修订过程。为解决这些问题，我们定义了从论文内容生成可编辑图形摘要的新任务，并提出了GenGA——一种直接以矢量格式生成图表的新框架。通过将图表作为具有层次结构的矢量元素集合生成，GenGA产生的输出可无缝导入现有绘图工具，实现直观的元素级编辑。此外，我们引入了结构独立系数（SIC），该指标基于局部修改对其他元素传播程度来量化图表的编辑简便性。实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，GenGA在编辑简便性上表现更优，甚至在简洁性和语义一致性方面超越了人工撰写的图形摘要。我们还验证了SIC作为与手动编辑成本相关联的有效度量。本研究从根本上将图形摘要生成重新定义为基于研究人员实际工作流程的可编辑矢量图形生成问题，显著促进了有效的科学传播。

summary: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, invoke tools, verify outcomes, and reuse experience across interactions. However, effective harness use raises two coupled challenges: state formation from noisy interaction traces and runtime control over external-state access. Existing agents usually handle both through prompts, heuristics, or domain-specific conventions, leaving the external workspace and its usage policy manually engineered. To address this, we study the problem of harness policy learning, where agents learn harness policies offline and deploy them to construct and update external harness state online during runtime task execution. We introduce EvoHarness-RL, which exposes Belief, Progress, and Experience (BPE) as policy-facing harness state. Supervised harness fine-tuning teaches the base agent the harness action space and how to construct useful external state, while cost-aware GRPO explores coordination policies to selectively read, update, and consolidate that state during long-horizon interaction. Instantiated on ALFWorld with a Qwen3-8B LLM, EvoHarness-RL reaches 96.9% success and reveals two key dynamics: harness annealing, where training internalizes recurring harness-use patterns into the model policy and shifts the agent from frequent harness calls toward selective external-state access, and harness evolution, where progress updates and experience consolidation refine the harness into a compact, task-adaptive state substrate. These results suggest that long-horizon agents benefit from trainable policies for constructing and coordinating with external harness workspaces, beyond simply adding stronger tools or larger memories.
title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: EvoHarness-RL：面向长时程大语言模型智能体的自演化运行时支撑框架学习
summary_translated: 长时程大语言模型智能体越来越多地依赖外部执行支持来维持状态、追踪进度、调用工具、验证结果，并在交互中复用经验。然而，有效使用支撑框架带来了两个相互关联的挑战：从噪声交互轨迹中形成状态，以及对外部状态访问的运行时控制。现有智能体通常通过提示词、启发式规则或领域特定惯例处理这两个问题，导致外部工作区及其使用策略需手动设计。为应对这一问题，我们研究了支撑框架策略学习的问题，即智能体在离线阶段学习支撑框架策略，并在运行时任务执行过程中在线构建和更新外部支撑状态。我们提出EvoHarness-RL，将信念、进展和经验（BPE）作为面向策略的支撑状态暴露给智能体。监督式支撑微调教会基础智能体支撑动作空间及如何构建有用的外部状态；而成本感知的GRPO则探索协调策略，以有选择地读取、更新和整合该状态，从而在长时程交互中实现高效协作。在ALFWorld上基于Qwen3-8B大模型实例化后，EvoHarness-RL达到96.9%的成功率，并揭示了两个关键动态：支撑框架退火，即训练将重复的支撑使用模式内化到模型策略中，使智能体从频繁调用支撑转向选择性访问外部状态；以及支撑框架演化，即进度更新和经验整合使支撑框架演变为紧凑、任务适应性的状态基底。这些结果表明，长时程智能体不仅需要更强的工具或更大的记忆，更受益于可训练的策略来构建并协调外部支撑工作区。

summary: Autoregressive large language model inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache. A dominant line of work reduces this footprint by evicting tokens that appear unimportant under attention-derived scores. However, such policies make an implicit irreversible decision: once a token is evicted, it cannot become useful again. We show that this assumption is brittle during decoding. Token and window importance drift as generated queries evolve, causing standard eviction policies to permanently discard states that later receive substantial attention under the full-cache model. To characterize this behaviour, we introduce Future Missed Mass and Global LIR, two diagnostics that measure future attention assigned to discarded states and the reactivation of historically inactive regions. We propose QEvict, a three-tier KV-cache management scheme that replaces binary retain-or-delete eviction with recoverable eviction. QEvict maintains high-confidence windows in full precision, stores intermediate windows in a quantized recoverable tier, and deletes only the lowest-confidence windows. During decoding, cumulative attention scores update window importance and when a quantized window becomes important again, it is dequantized and promoted to the full-precision. Under a fixed memory budget, this design preserves broader historical context while retaining exact full precision for the most important regions. Across long-context understanding, retrieval, and reasoning benchmarks, QEvict consistently improves over representative eviction and quantization baselines, reducing missed attention and improving information retention
title: QEvict: Recoverable Quantized KV Eviction for Attention-Drift-Robust Long-Context Decoding
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. The first four authors contributed equally
title_translated: QEvict：抗注意力漂移的长上下文解码中可恢复量化KV缓存淘汰机制
summary_translated: 自回归大语言模型推理日益受到键值（KV）缓存内存开销的制约。主流方法通过根据注意力得分淘汰被认为不重要的token来减少该开销。然而，这类策略隐含了一个不可逆的决策：一旦token被淘汰，便无法再次变得有用。我们指出，在解码过程中这一假设极为脆弱。随着生成查询的演变，token和窗口的重要性会发生漂移，导致标准淘汰策略永久丢弃那些在全缓存模型下后来获得大量注意力的状态。为刻画这一行为，我们引入了未来遗漏质量（Future Missed Mass）和全局LIR（Global LIR）两个诊断指标，分别衡量被丢弃状态在未来所获得的关注度以及历史非活跃区域的重新激活情况。我们提出QEvict，一种三层KV缓存管理方案，将二元保留或删除的淘汰策略替换为可恢复的淘汰机制。QEvict将高置信度窗口以全精度保存，中间窗口存储在量化可恢复层级，仅淘汰最低置信度的窗口。在解码过程中，累积注意力分数会更新窗口重要性；当某个量化窗口再次变得重要时，它会被去量化并提升至全精度层级。在固定内存预算下，该设计在保留更广泛历史上下文的同时，仍能对最重要区域保持精确全精度。在长上下文理解、检索和推理基准测试中，QEvict持续优于代表性淘汰和量化基线，减少了遗漏关注并提升了信息保留能力。

summary: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these two techniques. We propose EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator that resolves this incompatibility. In the prefill stage, the prompt-wise expert reuse reformulates routing as prompt-level expert reuse rather than independent per-token expert selection. It identifies important tokens using a lightweight encoder, constructs a shared expert set from them, and routes less important tokens with a reduced expert budget to lower expert EMA. In the decode stage, depth-aware expert coalescing exploits the contextual similarity and mutual exclusivity of same-depth candidate tokens. Rather than loading the union of all required channels, EdgeXpert loads only salient channels and applies computational calibration to recover accuracy without additional memory access. Synthesized in Samsung 28nm technology at 800 MHz, EdgeXpert achieves up to 56.3% latency reduction and 44.1% energy reduction compared to prior works, while maintaining near-baseline accuracy.
title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding
comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
title_translated: EdgeXpert：基于混合专家与推测解码的内存高效LLM推理边缘设备
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在设备端部署已成为个性化边缘应用的关键。主要瓶颈在于前馈网络（FFN）层中的外部内存访问（EMA）。推测解码和混合专家（MoE）是两种有前景的解决方案。推测解码通过每阶段生成多个token来减少解码阶段数，而MoE通过稀疏专家激活降低每阶段成本。然而，这两种技术在结合时存在不兼容性。我们提出EdgeXpert，一种软硬件协同设计的LLM加速器，解决了这一不兼容问题。在预填充阶段，提示级专家重用将路由重构为提示级专家重用，而非独立的逐token专家选择。它使用轻量编码器识别重要token，从中构建共享专家集，并对不重要token采用缩减的专家预算以降低专家EMA。在解码阶段，深度感知专家合并利用相同深度候选token之间的上下文相似性和互斥性。EdgeXpert不加载所有所需通道的并集，而是仅加载显著通道，并通过计算校准恢复精度，无需额外内存访问。在三星28nm工艺下以800MHz频率综合，EdgeXpert相比先前工作实现了最高56.3%的延迟降低和44.1%的能量节省，同时保持接近基线的准确性。

summary: The "decompose-then-verify" paradigm for LLM factuality evaluation faces a fundamental trade-off: atomic facts, i.e., one sentence conveying one unit of information, often omit essential context, while broader statements lack the granularity needed for precise assessment. To address this, we introduce TriQua, a framework that flexibly models facts based on their complexity. Simple claims are extracted as standard triples, while complex claims are represented as hyperrelational facts by attaching auxiliary contextual qualifiers. This adaptive structure preserves the necessary context for accurate retrieval and verification without sacrificing atomicity. Furthermore, TriQua's verification process directly annotates concrete errors within specific triples and qualifiers, providing fine-grained explainability for error detection. Alongside the framework, we propose TriQuaScore to quantify the factuality of these structured fact units. Empirical evaluations show that TriQuaScore strongly aligns with human annotated factuality scores, TriQua achieves robust decomposition quality, and outperforms existing decomposition-based frameworks in evidence-based fact verification.
title: TriQua: Reconciling Granularity and Context in Factuality Evaluation
title_translated: TriQua：在事实性评估中调和粒度与上下文的关系
summary_translated: 大语言模型事实性评估的“分解-验证”范式面临一个根本性权衡：原子事实（即一句表达一个信息单元）常遗漏必要上下文，而更宽泛的陈述又缺乏精确评估所需的粒度。为解决此问题，我们提出TriQua框架，可根据事实复杂度灵活建模。简单陈述被提取为标准三元组，而复杂陈述则通过附加辅助上下文限定词表示为超关系事实。这种自适应结构在不牺牲原子性的情况下保留了准确检索与验证所需的必要上下文。此外，TriQua的验证过程可直接标注特定三元组和限定词中的具体错误，提供细粒度的错误检测解释。除了框架本身，我们还提出TriQuaScore来量化这些结构化事实单元的事实性。实证评估显示，TriQuaScore与人工标注的事实性评分高度一致，TriQua展现出稳健的分解质量，并在基于证据的事实验证中优于现有分解式框架。

summary: Large language models often fail on reasoning tasks despite possessing the capability to solve them. We argue that many such failures arise from localized reasoning bugs in intermediate steps rather than from global incompetence. We show that these bugs are frequently repairable: inserting a short patch generated by a weak probe model after the same strong-model reasoning prefix can redirect the trajectory toward a correct solution.   However, this corrective effect is not reliably internalized by directly fine-tuning on weak patches or repaired trajectories, suggesting that the useful signal lies not in the intervention text itself, but in how it reshapes the model's future reasoning distribution. We therefore propose Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that learns from contrastive local interventions. Our method contrasts successful and unsuccessful weak-model patches at the same prefix, constructs a corrective teacher distribution from their induced future token predictions, and distills this signal into the strong model.   Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Woodpecker Distillation consistently improves strong-model performance and outperforms direct imitation baselines.
title: Woodpecker Distillation: Weak Models Diagnose Reasoning Bugs in Strong Models
title_translated: 啄木鸟蒸馏：弱模型诊断强模型中的推理缺陷
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在推理任务中经常失败，尽管它们具备解决这些任务的能力。我们认为，许多此类失败源于中间步骤中的局部推理缺陷，而非全局无能。我们表明，这些缺陷通常可修复：在强模型推理前缀后插入由弱探测模型生成的简短修补内容，可以引导模型走向正确解。然而，直接对弱修补内容或修复轨迹进行微调并不能可靠地内化这种修正效果，这表明有用信号并不在于干预文本本身，而在于其如何重塑模型未来的推理分布。因此，我们提出啄木鸟蒸馏（Woodpecker Distillation），一种从对比性局部干预中学习的弱到强训练框架。该方法在相同前缀下对比成功与失败的弱模型修补，基于其引发的未来标记预测构建修正教师分布，并将此信号蒸馏至强模型中。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，啄木鸟蒸馏能持续提升强模型性能，并优于直接模仿基线。

summary: We introduce the Ignition Index (I), a validated scalar metric that operationalizes Global Workspace Theory's (GWT) all-or-none ignition prediction in transformer language models. The metric fits a four-parameter sigmoid to per-layer linear probe accuracy as a function of input signal strength, extracting steepness parameter beta-hat: high values indicate abrupt, ignition-like transitions; low values indicate graded build-up. Across 11 models spanning five architecture families, shuffled-label controls demonstrate 9.6-fold selectivity for genuine linguistic structure over spurious probe capacity (p < 0.001, Mann-Whitney U-test). We find: (1) Feedforward transformers exceed SSMs by 89% in aggregate beta-hat (p < 1e-13, Cohen's d = 0.52), with Mamba exhibiting near-linear profiles consistent with absent global broadcast. (2) Huginn-3.5B exhibits 2.12-fold higher ignition along its iteration axis than its depth axis, demonstrating that recurrent architectures manifest workspace-like transitions along the recurrence dimension. (3) Pythia-410M shows a PELT-detected phase transition at training step 256 (+67%), preceding induction-head formation. (4) Hypotheses linking ignition to model scale and signal strength were not confirmed, suggesting transformer architectures may saturate available ignition mechanisms. The Ignition Index provides the first validated quantitative bridge between GWT's dynamical predictions and mechanistic interpretability, with 9.6-fold measurement selectivity and architecture-level discriminability not previously characterized in the scaling literature. title: The Ignition Index: Measuring Global Workspace Dynamics in Language Models

title_translated: 点火指数：测量语言模型中全局工作空间动态
summary_translated: 我们引入了点火指数（I），一个经过验证的标量指标，用于在Transformer语言模型中操作化全局工作空间理论（GWT）的全或无点火预测。该指标通过拟合四参数sigmoid函数，将每层线性探针准确率作为输入信号强度的函数，提取陡度参数beta-hat：高值表示突变式的、类似点火的转变；低值表示渐进式积累。在涵盖五个架构家族的11个模型中，打乱标签的对照实验显示，真实语言结构相对于虚假探针能力具有9.6倍的选择性（p < 0.001，Mann-Whitney U检验）。我们发现：（1）前馈Transformer在整体beta-hat上比状态空间模型（SSM）高出89%（p < 1e-13，Cohen's d = 0.52），而Mamba表现出近似线性的特征，与缺乏全局广播一致。（2）Huginn-3.5B在迭代轴上的点火程度是深度轴的2.12倍，表明循环架构在递归维度上表现出类工作空间的转变。（3）Pythia-410M在训练步数256处出现PELT检测到的相变（+67%），早于归纳头的形成。（4）关于点火与模型规模和信号强度关系的假设未被证实，提示Transformer架构可能已饱和于可用的点火机制。点火指数为GWT的动力学预测与机械可解释性之间提供了首个经过验证的定量桥梁，具有9.6倍的测量选择性和此前在缩放研究中未被描述的架构级区分能力。代码：https://github.com/saman-rahbar/ignition-index

summary: Enterprise operations extensively rely on multiple heterogeneous business systems and information applications, which also result in severe data silos and process fragmentation. Enterprises have invested considerable financial and material resources in building these applications, however, effectively leveraging and orchestrating them remains a formidable challenge. Conventional approaches to enterprise application integration, encompassing middleware architectures such as Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), API gateway infrastructures, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), suffer from inherent limitations like high architectural coupling, escalating operation and maintenance costs, and limited intelligence capabilities. This paper proposes Agentic Nesting, a multi-agent collaboration framework in which existing enterprise applications are encapsulated as autonomous AI agents within a hierarchically nested structure. Rather than flat interconnection, agents are organized into layered stewardship topologies that mirror the compositional complexity of enterprise ecosystems. The framework extracts a digital agent proxy from each legacy application to enable natural-language interaction and autonomous manipulation, coordinates multiple agents through a central orchestrator for task decomposition and dynamic dispatching, and exposes a unified conversational interface for cross-application querying and process orchestration. The main contributions of this paper are the proposition of the "Application-as-Agent" integration paradigm and the "Conversation-as-Integration" interaction philosophy, together with an exploration of the generalization potential of this methodology in scenarios encompassing heterogeneous system coordination, and large-scale data applications.
title: Agentic Nesting: A New Methodology for Existing Enterprise Application Integration and Services
title_translated: 代理嵌套：现有企业应用集成与服务的新方法论
summary_translated: 企业运营广泛依赖多个异构业务系统和信息应用，但也导致严重的数据孤岛和流程碎片化。企业已在这些应用上投入大量财力物力，但有效利用和编排它们仍是重大挑战。传统的应用集成方法，包括企业服务总线（ESB）、API网关基础设施和机器人流程自动化（RPA）等中间件架构，存在固有局限，如高架构耦合、运维成本上升以及智能能力有限。本文提出代理嵌套（Agentic Nesting），一种多代理协作框架，将现有企业应用封装为分层嵌套结构中的自主AI代理。不同于扁平连接，代理被组织成反映企业生态系统组合复杂性的层级治理拓扑。该框架从每个遗留应用中提取数字代理代理，实现自然语言交互与自主操作，通过中央协调器协调多个代理完成任务分解与动态调度，并提供统一的对话接口以支持跨应用查询与流程编排。本文的主要贡献包括提出“应用即代理”集成范式和“对话即集成”交互哲学，并探索该方法在异构系统协同与大规模数据应用等场景下的泛化潜力。

summary: Despite the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) in code generation, existing evaluations focus on functional correctness or syntactic validity, overlooking how LLMs make critical design choices such as which library or programming language to use. To fill this gap, we perform the first empirical study of LLMs' preferences for libraries and programming languages when generating code, covering eight diverse LLMs. We observe a strong tendency to overuse widely adopted libraries such as NumPy; in up to 45% of cases, this usage is not required and deviates from the ground-truth solutions. The LLMs we study also show a significant preference toward Python as their default language. For high-performance project initialisation tasks where Python is not the optimal language, it remains the dominant choice in 58% of cases, and Rust is not used once. These results highlight how LLMs prioritise familiarity and popularity over suitability and task-specific optimality; underscoring the need for targeted fine-tuning, data diversification, and evaluation benchmarks that explicitly measure language and library selection fidelity.
title: A Study of LLMs' Preferences for Libraries and Programming Languages

title_translated: 大语言模型对库和编程语言偏好的研究
summary_translated: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成方面取得了快速进展，但现有评估主要关注功能正确性或语法有效性，忽略了LLMs在关键设计决策（如选择何种库或编程语言）上的表现。为填补这一空白，我们首次对八种不同LLMs在生成代码时对库和编程语言的偏好进行了实证研究。我们观察到LLMs强烈倾向于过度使用广泛采用的库，如NumPy；在高达45%的情况下，这种使用并非必需，且偏离了真实解决方案。我们研究的LLMs也表现出对Python作为默认语言的显著偏好。在高性能项目初始化任务中，Python并非最优语言，但它仍占据58%的主导地位，而Rust从未被使用。这些结果凸显了LLMs更重视熟悉度和流行度，而非适用性和任务特定最优性；强调需要针对性微调、数据多样化以及明确衡量语言和库选择准确性的评估基准。
